top.line: An agentic console, simulated in a public vault: the control room that makes an agentic brain sellable.
top.para: Trust zones, time to rewind, signed messages on three channels, honest stops, a view per person, and the console as an agent.

in-short.line: What we sell, the demo, time, trust zones, the conversation, and the console as an agent.

why.line: A customer cannot buy a brain they cannot see or control.
why.para: A console like a power station's, for agents.

customers.line: Read backwards: ruv.sgit.ai, the book, Web Summit; RiskMandate a partner; PrompTugal.news a customer.
customers.para: All needed a way to see and control the agents.

console.line: Ten accounts as trust zones, zoom to an account and an agent, three channels, time, stops, views, talk.
console.para: Every view shows the state at the moment you choose.

awareness.line: Perceive, understand, project, act; colour only for exceptions.
awareness.para: Endsley's situation awareness and the ISA-101 idea of a calm screen.

sell.line: The console is the selling point; skills, principles and open pieces let anyone replicate it.
sell.para: We sell the setup: time, trust and execution.

limits.line: A simulation with real people, zones and names; nothing live; history as a reading, not contracts.

sources.line: My own thinking, the team site, Endsley and ISA-101 summaries.
